drawable_creators.layers: 'background' (also seen: 'artwork', 'overlay'); see ui.json calls[] for what the scripts use

note: Per class, the method list of metatable.__index. Every object of a class shares one flat method table (the metatable is its own __index; there is no further __index chain and no Lua-level inheritance: each class simply lists all methods, including the ~90 common widget methods). A widget is a Lua table {__this = userdata, <script-defined fields>}. Drawables (image/color/text/ninepart/threepart/iconimage/effect) and the text style object (.style / .titleStyle) are the same kind of table. GetId() is a creation counter (hex string) for widgets and meaningless for drawables/styles. Widget NAMES, textures, coords, colours, fonts, anchors and layers have no getters.

textstyle.note: object behind widget.style / titleStyle; created natively with label/button/textbox
